text: Walking through these modern, open spaces in Nanjing, I feel both grounded and uplifted. The design of the gallery, its interplay of colors, light, and interactive elements, evokes a sense of ingenuity and anticipation. I am reminded how philosophy is not just an abstract discipline, but something shaped by the environments in which we find ourselves. Here, history and innovation converge, inviting me to reflect, to slow down, and to appreciate the beauty of thoughtful spaces. I feel quietly inspired, hoping to carry this calm curiosity into my next encounter.
